scope: LISS-owned inter-enterprise inference contracting semantics over the persistent cheapest-sufficient broker

solicit-service.terms: provider-authored job digest, registry digest, comparable expected resolution consideration, and quoted supplier path

invoke-service.completion: the response settles admission only and never waits for provider completion
invoke-service.effect: provider-local append and one broker.admit call

query-service.authorization: the querying actor must be the buyer bound to the admitted contract

invariants: the adapter shares the one persistent LISS broker and never creates another scheduler
every ingress is exactly addressed to urn:ame:logical-inference-service-section before broker state is read or changed
a provider offer is bound to exact job bytes, comparable consideration, one registry digest, and one buyer
invocation accepts either exact bytes or the immutable id of a provider-issued offer and always resolves the canonical offer from LISS's journal before checking the actor-bound attenuated capability
broker admission is asynchronous and returns an immediate typed receipt
provider offers contracts submission responses ownership bindings inquiries and refusals are append-only LISS records
startup replays the ActivityStreams journal in causal order before either persistent carrier accepts ingress
changed activity-id bytes, changed job-id bytes, stale registry offers, buyer swaps, and unauthorized result inquiries are refused
unknown and unauthorized job inquiries share a non-disclosing authorization refusal
result inquiry never exposes a different buyer's prompt result or job existence
mutable caller envelope references are never retained as adapter state
x402 authorization payment and settlement are not claimed by this contract

currentCarriers: mode-0600 host-local Unix socket for supervised host clients
long-lived bounded stdin/stdout JSONL process for pipes, batch workers, and sandboxes that cannot bind a socket
boundary.carrierEquivalence: both carriers attach the same ActivityStreams adapter to the same persistent broker state machine and append-only journals
boundary.networkActivityPub: missing separately hireable Web Services Section > ActivityPub Services Section provider; no network federation is claimed
boundary.x402: owned by the separately hireable metered-inference-tollbooth and any funded facilitator it contracts

supersedesForNewProcurement: liss-inference-service synchronous child-process route; retained as contract-routed-inference-legacy for compatibility
